name: Weather Alerts
description: Active severe weather warnings from NOAA (US), ECCC (Canada), DWD (Germany), and MeteoAlarm (Europe)

noaa.purpose: US weather alerts (warnings, watches, advisories) with polygon boundaries
noaa.dataSent: No user data (static active alerts feed)
noaa.dataReceived: GeoJSON with polygon geometries; headline, event, severity, urgency, description, instruction, onset/expires

eccc.purpose: Canadian weather alerts with polygon boundaries
eccc.dataSent: No user data (static active alerts feed)
eccc.dataReceived: GeoJSON with alert type, name (EN/FR), urgency, confidence, publication/expiration, province, polygon geometry

dwd.purpose: German weather warnings with municipality-level polygon boundaries
dwd.dataSent: No user data (static active warnings feed)
dwd.dataReceived: GeoJSON with municipality polygons; headline, event, severity, urgency, description, instruction, onset/expires

meteoalarm.purpose: European weather alerts (24 countries, excl. Germany). No polygon geometry — country centroid used.
meteoalarm.dataReceived: Atom XML with CAP entries: event, severity, urgency, certainty, onset/expires, area description
